items.title: Ford (F) Stock Looks Fairly Valued Despite Its 23% Run

items.title: What Does Ford Motor (F) Michigan Battery Lead Mean For Its EV Supply Chain?
items.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) is under political fire over its use of Chinese battery technology at a Michigan plant that is already operating. General Motors is pushing sodium-ion battery research to build U.S. battery capacity and limit reliance on Chinese suppliers. The two Detroit automakers are intensifying efforts to secure domestic battery supply chains for future electric vehicle production. items.title: Ford's CEO urges caution on Chinese automakers, says Europe is 'too late'
items.summary: Sept 29 (Reuters) - Ford CEO Jim Farley said that the US must carefully weigh how and whether Chinese ‌automakers should enter the American market, and pointed to Europe as ‌a cautionary tale. Farley said at an Automotive News conference on Tuesday that the US must “be ​extremely careful around how the Chinese OEMs come to our country,” and cited the pressure on Europe’s auto industry as Chinese imports quickly grab market share there.

items.title: Stellantis Falls 4% With Canadian Labor Standoff Unresolved; Ford and General Motors Dip
